item.text:
Date: {{DATE}}

The Board of Directors

{{COMPANY_NAME}}

{{COMPANY_REGISTERED_ADDRESS}}

Dear Sir(s),

We refer to the captioned matters and enclose herewith the following for your attention:

ops.insert:
Dear Sir(s),

We refer to the captioned matters and enclose herewith the following for your attention:
We refer to your Audited Financial Statements for the financial year ended

and advise that the said Audited Financial Statements must be presented at an Annual General Meeting (AGM) so that the Annual Return (AR) can be lodged with the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) to indicate that the AGM has been held.
For the purpose of holding this AGM, we enclose herewith the following for your attention:
Directors' Resolution to receive and adopt the Audited Financial Statements for the year ended
which is to be signed by the Director(s) named therein.
Directors’ Resolution relating to the Minutes by a representative of holding company to be signed by the Director(s) named therein.
Letter of Authority for filing of XBRL
ANNUAL COMPLIANCE FOR REGISTER OF REGISTRABLE CONTROLLERS AND REGISTER OF NOMINEE DIRECTORS (YEAR
sets of Form(s) for the change of Registrable Controllers to be signed by person(s) named therein.
sets of Registrable Controllers Form to be signed by person(s) named therein.
set(s) of Director’s Declaration Form to be signed by the Director(s) named therein.
MANDATORY CLIENT DUE DILIGENCE DOCUMENTS REQUIRED BY ACRA
Customer Declaration Form to be signed by the persons named therein.
List of Documents to be Requested

For administrative convenience, we have left the date of the documents blank. Kindly inform us when the Annual General Meeting would be held so that we can proceed with the dating of the documents upon receipt.
The AR should be checked carefully and please sign in the places where indicated.
Kindly arrange for the above documents to be signed and returned to us for our further action.

Please note that pursuant to Section 203 of the Companies Act, each shareholder of the Company is entitled to a copy of the Audited Financial Statements. We would therefore advise that after the Audited Financial Statements have been signed a copy be sent to every shareholder 14 days before the date of the Annual General Meeting.
* This is a computer-generated letter and no signature is required.

A member of the Company entitled to attend and vote at the General Meeting is entitled to appoint a proxy to attend and vote in his/her stead. A proxy need not be a member of the Company. The instrument appointing a proxy must be deposited at the registered office of the Company not less than 48/72 hours before the time set for holding on the meeting.

Pursuant to Section 177(3)(b) and Section 203 of the Companies Act, shareholder(s) will be asked to consent to the transaction of the business as detailed in the Notice, notwithstanding that the full notice prescribed had not been given.
